# EvToast

> A toast is a brief, auto-dismissing notification that appears over the interface to confirm an action or surface a status message without interrupting the user's flow.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| ID | `evoq-ui:toast` |
| Layer | Molecule (`src/molecules`) |
| Import | `import { EvToast } from 'evoq-ui'` |
| Template tag | `<EvToast>` or `<ev-toast>` |
| Source | `src/molecules/toast/EvToast.vue` |
| Extra attributes go to | the root `<div class="ev-toast">` |

## Example

```vue
<EvToast
  variant="success"
  title="Faktur berhasil dikirim"
/>
```

## Design guidance

From the Figma page **Toast**, frame `4518:85548` (Toast). These rules are binding. Names in them are Figma's - the Vue API is the tables above.

### When to use

- Use to confirm an action or report a status non-intrusively — saved changes, errors, sync results. Pick the Type that matches the message’s severity.

### When not to use

- Don't use for critical messages that require a decision — use a Modal or Alert Dialog (`evoq-ui:alert-dialog`). Don't pack long content or multiple actions into a toast.

### Do

- Keep the message to one short line. Auto-dismiss after a few seconds, and always allow manual close. Stack multiple toasts rather than overlapping them.

### Don't

- Don't auto-dismiss error toasts the user must act on — keep them until dismissed. Don't show many toasts at once or place them where they cover key controls.

## Contract

- Only the props, slots and events above exist on `EvToast`; anything not listed is not part of its API.
- An attribute that is not a prop (`class`, `id`, `aria-*`, `data-*`) goes to the root `<div class="ev-toast">`.
- Import it by name from `evoq-ui`; styles come once from `evoq-ui/style.css`.
- Refer to it by id `evoq-ui:toast` - the id stays the same if the component moves layer.
